patches.find: \item \textbf{Efficiency-Focused Design}: Unlike existing methods that prioritize absolute accuracy at the cost of computational resources, KG-NAS adopts an efficiency-first design philosophy targeting resource-constrained deployment scenarios. The discovered 5.3M-parameter student attains 82.4\% AUROC on MVTec-AD, matching 98.2\% of the average AUROC of a 12.9M ResNet-18 student trained under an identical protocol at less than half the parameter count. We further characterize how this comparison depends on the training budget (Section~\ref{subsec:main_results}). Cross-dataset evaluation across three datasets (MVTec-AD, VisA, BTAD) reveals dataset-dependent architectural preferences: CNNs dominate for texture-based defects (MVTec-AD, BTAD), while Transformers excel for complex structures (VisA 75\%). This automatic adaptation eliminates manual architecture selection, enabling rapid deployment across diverse industrial scenarios without requiring domain expertise.
patches.replace: \item \textbf{Deployment-Oriented Discovery with a Measured Capacity Envelope}: KG-NAS targets deployment scenarios in which architecture engineering is the bottleneck rather than absolute accuracy. Without any manual architecture design the discovered 5.3M-parameter student attains 82.4\% AUROC on MVTec-AD, exceeding the classical embedding-based and teacher--student baselines (PaDiM 77.9\%, Reverse Distillation 80.5\%, PatchCore 50.6\%, STPM 51.1\%) on both accuracy and size. We also delimit the framework honestly: a five-band capacity study (Section~\ref{subsec:capacity}) shows that varying the parameter budget over a $9.2\times$ range leaves accuracy statistically unchanged, so the remaining gap to recent high-capacity detectors (CFA 89.8\%, EfficientAD 97.5\%) is methodological rather than budgetary. patches.find: Extensive ablations validate each component: dynamic alignment contributes +5.2\% AUROC, the searched student attains 82.4\% AUROC on MVTec-AD (above PaDiM and Reverse Distillation), and no fixed architecture dominates all categories. Cross-dataset evaluation confirms KG-NAS's adaptability to diverse data characteristics. These findings establish KG-NAS as a practical solution for automated architecture discovery in resource-constrained industrial anomaly detection.
